bullets.text: The Ministry of Electronics and IT released the indigenous foundation models EKA-1 and Dhīr under the IndiaAI Innovation Centre pillar, and our office should monitor national AI capability adoption.
A new report shows 97 percent of Indian professionals want to learn more about AI and 88 percent expect productivity gains, so our department should note rising workforce training demand.
Union Minister Pralhad Joshi stated that the AI boom will drive demand for clean and affordable power, and our office should watch energy planning for future data center expansions.

stories.title: IndiaAI Mission Released Indigenous Foundation Models EKA-1 by Soket and Dhīr 2B & Dhīr 5B by ZenteiQ Under the IndiaAI Innovation Centre Pillar
takeaways: Ministry of Electronics and IT released indigenous foundation models EKA-1 and Dhīr under the IndiaAI Mission.
EKA-1 features 26.3 billion parameters supporting 22 scheduled Indian languages for advanced agentic use.
stories.snippet: Ministry of Electronics & IT EKA-1 by Soket Features 26.3 Billion Parameters Trained on Approximately 7.5 Trillion Tokens Across All 22 Scheduled Indian Languages and English for Math, Code, Reasoning & Agentic Use…

stories.title: 97% Indian Professionals Want to Learn More About AI, Report Finds
takeaways: Ninety seven percent of Indian professionals want to learn more about artificial intelligence skills.
Eighty eight percent expect the technology to improve overall workplace productivity significantly.

stories.title: AI boom to drive demand for clean, affordable power: Pralhad Joshi
takeaways: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi highlighted that the AI boom will drive demand for clean power.
Ensuring affordable and clean electricity access remains critical for rising artificial intelligence adoption.

stories.title: Chief Justice of India CJI Surya Kant inaugurates data centre at Jharkhand High Court
takeaways: Chief Justice of India CJI Surya Kant inaugurated a state-of-the-art data centre at Jharkhand High Court.
The facility in Ranchi aims to enhance the technological capabilities of the judicial infrastructure.
